scope: 七本既有冒險的 master/mistress、職銜、複合詞、level、court、host、order、character 及表情比喻專項覆核；不宣稱全書逐句校對。

corrections.english: When it comes to sharing information about their dark master, Strahd's Vistani pretend to be helpful, but the information they impart is misleading at best and often deceptive. They readily tell adventurers that they have a potion that protects them from the deadly fog that surrounds Barovia. Although this is a lie, they attempt to sell their fake potion for as much money as they can get.
corrections.before: 當涉及到分享關於他們黑暗大師的資訊時，施特拉德的維斯塔尼人假裝樂於助人，但他們所提供的資訊充其量是誤導性的，而且往往是欺騙性的。他們輕易地告訴冒險者們，他們有一種藥水可以保護他們免受巴洛維亞周圍致命迷霧的侵害。儘管這是個謊言，他們仍試圖以儘可能高的價格出售他們的假藥水。
corrections.zh_tw: 當涉及到分享關於他們黑暗主人的資訊時，施特拉德的維斯塔尼人假裝樂於助人，但他們所提供的資訊充其量是誤導性的，而且往往是欺騙性的。他們輕易地告訴冒險者們，他們有一種藥水可以保護他們免受巴洛維亞周圍致命迷霧的侵害。儘管這是個謊言，他們仍試圖以儘可能高的價格出售他們的假藥水。
reasons: master 指維斯塔尼人效忠的施特拉德。

corrections.english: The burgomaster's monstrous henchman, {@creature Izek Strazni|CoS} (see {@area appendix D|77c|x}), sleeps here at night. During the day, he is in town taking care of his master's business. Izek's chest is unlocked and contains a heap of wrinkled clothes, under which is a nonmagical shortsword.
corrections.before: 鎮長的怪物親信，{@creature Izek Strazni|CoS|艾澤克·施特拉茲尼}（見{@area 附錄D|77c|x}），在黑夜中睡在這裡。白晝時，他在小鎮中處理他大師的事務。艾澤克的箱子沒有上鎖，裡面有一堆皺巴巴的衣服，衣服下面是一把非魔法的短劍。
corrections.zh_tw: 鎮長的怪物親信，{@creature Izek Strazni|CoS|艾澤克·施特拉茲尼}（見{@area 附錄D|77c|x}），在黑夜中睡在這裡。白晝時，他在小鎮中替主人辦事。艾澤克的箱子沒有上鎖，裡面有一堆皺巴巴的衣服，衣服下面是一把非魔法的短劍。
reasons: 艾澤克是鎮長的親信，非學徒。

corrections.english: The druids who worship Strahd as lord of the land and master of the weather convene here, atop Yester Hill, on the very edge of Strahd's domain. This hill is also where the evil blights that walk the Svalich Woods are born, and where Strahd comes on occasion to glimpse his ancestral home.
corrections.before: 崇拜施特拉德為大地之主與天氣大師的德魯伊們聚集於此，在施特拉德領地邊緣的往日山丘之上。這座丘陵也是遊蕩於斯瓦里奇森林的邪惡枯萎怪們的誕生之地，施特拉德偶爾會來此瞥見他的祖居。
corrections.zh_tw: 崇拜施特拉德為大地之主與天候的掌控者的德魯伊們聚集於此，在施特拉德領地邊緣的往日山丘之上。這座丘陵也是遊蕩於斯瓦里奇森林的邪惡枯萎怪們的誕生之地，施特拉德偶爾會來此瞥見他的祖居。
reasons: master of the weather 指對天候的支配。

corrections.english: "Master!" says a voice from behind you. An elf with dusky brown skin and long black hair, his face a mask of terror, looks on what you have wrought and screams.
corrections.before: "大師！"一個聲音從你身後傳來。一個有著深褐色皮膚和黑色長髮的精靈，他的臉上帶著恐懼的面具，看著你所造成的景象並尖叫起來。
corrections.zh_tw: "主人！"一個聲音從你身後傳來。一個有著深褐色皮膚和黑色長髮的精靈，滿臉驚恐，看著你所造成的景象並尖叫起來。
reasons: 拉哈丁呼喚自己侍奉的施特拉德。
mask of terror 是表情，非實體面具。

corrections.english: The spiral staircase has no railing and connects the main floor of the castle with each level above it. First, the staircase climbs 50 feet to a landing (shown on {@adventure map 4|CoS|5|Map 4: Court of the Count}), from which an open archway leads to {@area area K13|1c1|x}. East of that opening is a secret door that conceals a ladder leading down to {@area area K34|1fd|x}.
corrections.before: 螺旋樓梯沒有扶手，連線著城堡的主樓面及其上方的每個等級。首先，樓梯爬升50尺到達一個平臺（顯示在{@adventure 地圖 4|CoS|5|Map 4: Court of the Count}上），從那裡一個敞開的拱廊通往{@area 區域K13|1c1|x}。在那個開口的東邊是一扇暗門，隱藏著一個通往{@area 區域K34|1fd|x}的梯子。
corrections.zh_tw: 螺旋樓梯沒有扶手，使城堡的主樓層與上方各樓層相通。首先，樓梯爬升50尺到達一個平臺（顯示在{@adventure 地圖 4|CoS|5|Map 4: Court of the Count}上），從那裡一個敞開的拱廊通往{@area 區域K13|1c1|x}。在那個開口的東邊是一扇暗門，隱藏著一個通往{@area 區域K34|1fd|x}的梯子。
reasons: level 指建築樓層。
避免通用繁化將建築的連接再換成網路語境的連線。

corrections.english: Once the trapdoor has been found and opened, it remains available to characters as a way into and out of the dungeon level.
corrections.before: 一旦找到並開啟活板門，角色們就可以利用它作為進出地下城等級的方式。
corrections.zh_tw: 一旦找到並開啟活板門，它就會一直保持可用，讓角色們作為進出地牢層的通道。
reasons: dungeon level 指地牢樓層；保留 remains available。

corrections.english: This suit symbolizes faith, spirituality, and inner strength. It is the suit of priests and those who devote themselves to the service of a deity, a higher power, or a heightened philosophy. On the side of good, it represents willpower and dedication. On the side of evil, the suit signifies weakness of character, self-doubt, and betrayal of one's ideals or beliefs. It symbolizes health and healing, as well as illness and disease.
corrections.before: 雕紋牌組象徵著信仰、靈性和內在力量。它是祭司們的牌組，也是那些致力於將人生奉獻給神性、超自然力或者某種崇高哲學的人的牌組。從好的方面來說,它體現了意志力和奉獻。從壞的方面來說，它代表著角色的弱點、自我懷疑、對理想和信仰的背叛。它同時也象徵著健康和治療、疾患與病痛。
corrections.zh_tw: 雕紋牌組象徵著信仰、靈性和內在力量。它是祭司們的牌組，也是那些致力於將人生奉獻給神性、超自然力或者某種崇高哲學的人的牌組。從好的方面來說,它體現了意志力和奉獻。從壞的方面來說，它代表著性格上的軟弱、自我懷疑、對理想和信仰的背叛。它同時也象徵著健康和治療、疾患與病痛。
reasons: weakness of character 是品性而非遊戲角色弱點。

corrections.english: If the beacon has not been lit, the body is serving as a host for the revenant. If the characters approach it, it says, "Go away." If they don't leave immediately, read:
corrections.before: 若信標還未點亮，這具身軀正擔當著還魂鬼的主人。如果角色們靠近它，它會說：「快離開。」如果他們不立即離開，讀出：
corrections.zh_tw: 若信標還未點亮，這具身軀正作為還魂鬼的宿主。如果角色們靠近它，它會說：「快離開。」如果他們不立即離開，讀出：
reasons: host 指靈體寄居的身軀。

corrections.english: {@creature Stanimir|CoS}'s face becomes a somber mask. "A curse has befallen our noble prince, turning him into a tyrant. We alone have the power to leave his domain. We've traveled far and wide to find heroes such as yourselves to end our dread lord's curse and put his troubled soul to rest. Our leader, {@creature Madam Eva|CoS}, knows all. Will you return to Barovia with us and speak with her?"
corrections.before: {@creature Stanimir|CoS|斯塔尼米爾}的臉變得像一副憂鬱的面具。"一個詛咒降臨到我們高貴的王子身上了，將他變成了一位暴君。只有我們有能力離開他的領地。我們長途跋涉尋找像你們這樣的英雄來結束我們恐懼之王的詛咒，讓他飽受困擾的靈魂獲得安息。我們的首領，{@creature Madam Eva|CoS|伊娃夫人}，知道所有事情。你們願意隨我們回到巴洛維亞並與她交談嗎？"
corrections.zh_tw: {@creature Stanimir|CoS|斯塔尼米爾}的神情變得凝重。"一個詛咒降臨到我們高貴的王子身上了，將他變成了一位暴君。只有我們有能力離開他的領地。我們長途跋涉尋找像你們這樣的英雄來結束我們可畏的領主的詛咒，讓他飽受困擾的靈魂獲得安息。我們的首領，{@creature Madam Eva|CoS|伊娃夫人}，知道所有事情。你們願意隨我們回到巴洛維亞並與她交談嗎？"
reasons: somber mask 描述表情。
dread lord 為可畏的領主而非恐懼之王專名。

corrections.english: All creatures trapped inside the elevator (including {@condition unconscious} ones) must roll initiative. The compartment takes 1 round to reach the top of the shaft, stopping just beneath {@area area K47|225|x}. Each creature inside has one turn to act before the compartment comes to a dead stop. Their initiative rolls determine the order in which the occupants act. Conscious party members can take whatever actions they like. They might search for a way out, wake sleeping party members, cast spells, or take other actions. {@condition Unconscious} ones can do nothing.
corrections.before: 所有被困在升降梯內的生物（包括{@condition unconscious||昏迷}者）必須擲先攻。轎廂需要一輪時間到達豎井頂部，停在{@area 區域K47|225|x}正下方。每個轎廂內的生物在轎廂完全停止前有一回合的行動時間。他們的先攻骰決定居住者行動的秩序。清醒的隊員可以採取任意動作。他們可以搜尋出路、喚醒沉睡的隊員、施展法術或執行其他動作。{@condition Unconscious||昏迷}者則什麼都做不了。
corrections.zh_tw: 所有被困在升降梯內的生物（包括{@condition unconscious||昏迷}者）必須擲先攻。轎廂需要一輪時間到達豎井頂部，停在{@area 區域K47|225|x}正下方。每個轎廂內的生物在轎廂完全停止前有一回合的行動時間。他們的先攻骰決定乘員行動的順序。清醒的隊員可以採取任意動作。他們可以搜尋出路、喚醒沉睡的隊員、施展法術或執行其他動作。{@condition Unconscious||昏迷}者則什麼都做不了。
reasons: 電梯 occupants 是乘員；initiative order 是行動順序。

corrections.english: "If you have come to free this land from the creature that feasts on the blood of the innocent, know this: There is no monster I hate more than {@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS}. He slew Argynvost, broke the life of the knight I loved, and destroyed the valiant order to which I devoted my life, but Strahd has already died once. He can't be allowed to die again. Instead, he must suffer eternally in a hell of his own creation, from which he can never escape. Whatever can be done to bring him misery and unrest, I will do, but I will destroy anyone who tries to end his torment."
corrections.before: "如果你來此是為了從嗜食無辜者鮮血的生物手中解放這片土地，應要知曉：沒有比{@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS|施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇}更令我憎恨的怪物。他殺害了奧金弗斯特，奪走了我所愛騎士的生命，並摧毀了我畢生奉獻的英勇秩序，但施特拉德已經死過一次。絕不能讓他再次死去。相反，他必須在他自己創造的、永世無法逃脫的地獄中承受永恆的痛苦。只要能給他帶來痛苦與不安，我都會去做，但我會摧毀任何試圖結束他折磨的人。"
corrections.zh_tw: "如果你來此是為了從嗜食無辜者鮮血的生物手中解放這片土地，應要知曉：沒有比{@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS|施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇}更令我憎恨的怪物。他殺害了奧金弗斯特，奪走了我所愛騎士的生命，並摧毀了我畢生奉獻的英勇騎士團，但施特拉德已經死過一次。絕不能讓他再次死去。相反，他必須在他自己創造的、永世無法逃脫的地獄中承受永恆的痛苦。只要能給他帶來痛苦與不安，我都會去做，但我會摧毀任何試圖結束他折磨的人。"
reasons: order 指銀龍騎士團。

corrections.english: If your card reading reveals that Sir Godfrey is Strahd's enemy and the characters persuasively ask him for help, he offers to join the fight against the vampire. Fate has unlocked his memory of the love that he and Vladimir once shared, and the power of that memory drives Godfrey to help fight Strahd and restore the order's honor.
corrections.before: 如果你的卡牌占卜揭示出高德弗裡爵士是施特拉德的敵人，且角色們有說服力地請求他協助，他會提出加入對抗吸血鬼的戰鬥。命運喚醒了他與弗拉基米爾曾經共享的愛的記憶，這記憶的力量驅使高德弗裡協助對抗施特拉德並重拾秩序的榮譽。
corrections.zh_tw: 如果你的卡牌占卜揭示出高德弗裡爵士是施特拉德的敵人，且角色們有說服力地請求他協助，他會提出加入對抗吸血鬼的戰鬥。命運喚醒了他與弗拉基米爾曾經共享的愛的記憶，這記憶的力量驅使高德弗裡協助對抗施特拉德並重拾騎士團的榮譽。
reasons: order 指銀龍騎士團。

corrections.english: {@creature Vladimir Horngaard|CoS} and the other revenants that haunt Barovia see the light as a reminder of all that was once good and noble about the knightly order to which they once belonged. They let go of their hatred and their corporeal bodies, leaving corpses behind as their spirits find rest at long last. Henceforth, any random encounter with a revenant should be treated as no encounter.
corrections.before: {@creature Vladimir Horngaard|CoS|弗拉基米爾·霍恩嘉德} 與其他作祟於巴洛維亞的還魂鬼們看見這光芒，彷彿在提醒著他們曾經所屬的騎士秩序中所有善良與高尚的事物。他們放下了仇恨與肉身，留下屍體，讓他們的精魂最終找到了安息。此後，任何與還魂鬼的隨機遭遇都應視為無遭遇。
corrections.zh_tw: {@creature Vladimir Horngaard|CoS|弗拉基米爾·霍恩嘉德} 與其他作祟於巴洛維亞的還魂鬼們看見這光芒，彷彿在提醒著他們曾經所屬的騎士團中所有善良與高尚的事物。他們放下了仇恨與肉身，留下屍體，讓他們的精魂最終找到了安息。此後，任何與還魂鬼的隨機遭遇都應視為無遭遇。
reasons: knightly order 指組織。

corrections.english: Rumbling thunder pounds the castle spires. The wind's howling increases as Strahd turns his gaze back to the village. Far below, yet not beyond his ken, a party of adventurers has just entered his domain. Strahd's face forms a twisted smile as his dark plan unfolds. He knew they were coming, and he knows why they have come—all according to his plan. He, the master of Ravenloft, will attend to them.
corrections.before: 滾雷砸在城堡的塔尖上。風聲越發淒厲，施特拉德將視線轉回地上的村子。村子非常遠，但他依然看得清楚。一隊冒險者剛剛進入他的領地。隨著他那邪惡的計劃逐漸展開，施特拉德露出了扭曲的微笑。他知道這些人要來，也知道他們為什麼要求——這都是他一手策劃的。而他，鴉閣城堡的主人，將盛情"款待"它們。
corrections.zh_tw: 滾雷砸在城堡的塔尖上。風聲越發淒厲，施特拉德將視線轉回地上的村子。村子非常遠，但他依然看得清楚。一隊冒險者剛剛進入他的領地。隨著他那邪惡的計劃逐漸展開，施特拉德露出了扭曲的微笑。他知道這些人要來，也知道他們為何而來——這都是他一手策劃的。而他，鴉閣城堡的主人，將盛情"款待"他們。
reasons: why they have come 不是要求。

corrections.english: Inspired by Tiamat, Severin reexamined the texts translated by Sammaster and discovered a different interpretation, believing that "naught will be left save shattered thrones, with no rulers but the dead. Dragons shall rule the world entire..." Severin's quest to reshape the cult led him to the dragon Hoondarrh, "the Red Rage of Mintarn." The fact that Severin not only survived this encounter but befriended the dragon impressed Tiamat in her exile in the Nine Hells. As a reward and further test, she allowed Severin a scrap of knowledge regarding the existence of the five dragon masks. Severin took that bit of information and did what few others could have accomplished, searching for and finding all five masks. The task took years to complete, and it led directly to the crisis that Faerûn now faces.
corrections.before: 受到提亞馬特的啟發，賽維林重新審視了薩姆大師翻譯的文字，並發現了一種不同的解釋，他相信"除了破碎的寶座，沒有統治者，只有死者。龍將統治整個世界..."賽維林重塑邪教的追求引導他找到了龍胡恩達爾，"敏塔恩的紅色憤怒"。賽維林不僅在這次遭遇中倖存下來，而且還與龍成為了朋友，這讓在九層地獄流亡的提亞馬特印象深刻。作為獎勵和進一步的考驗，她允許賽維林獲得了有關五個龍面具存在的一小塊知識。賽維林利用這些資訊，完成了很少有人能夠完成的任務，尋找並找到了所有五個面具。這項任務耗時數年才完成，並且直接導致了費倫現在面臨的危機。

corrections.english: A young man walks up to you, limping heavily on his bandaged left leg. "I hear that you intend to follow the raiders and see where they've gone. I'd like nothing better than to come with you, but in this condition, I'd slow you down. In the midst of all this tragedy, there's no reason you would have heard about the fate of my master, {@creature Leosin Erlanthar|HotDQ}, but it's important you know. He is a monk from Berdusk. He disappeared last night, after we fought a particularly savage battle against raiders. A few others and I fought our way to the keep, barely. Leosin didn't make it at all. We went back this morning to look for him, but all we found was his broken staff and this choker, which he always wore."

corrections.english: {@creature Ontharr Frume|HotDQ} represents the Order of the Gauntlet. His order shares many of the Harpers' principles, but the two organizations are very different. The Order of the Gauntlet emphasizes faith, vigilance, and constant struggle against threats of evil. Many of its members are clerics and paladins, but the order welcomes anyone who shares its ideals. Discipline is key, and the order is distinctly more structured and hierarchical than the Harpers.
corrections.before: {@creature Ontharr Frume|HotDQ|昂塔爾·弗魯姆} 代表鐵手套教團。他的秩序和豎琴手們分享許多原則，但這兩個組織非常不同。鐵手套教團強調信仰、警惕以及對邪惡威脅的持續鬥爭。它的許多成員是牧師和聖武士，但秩序歡迎任何分享其理想的人。紀律是關鍵，並且秩序在結構和等級制度上明顯比豎琴手們更加嚴格和有層次。

corrections.english: Harpers can be recognized by the group's symbol: a silver harp nestled between the horns of a crescent moon. Some people wear the symbol openly, and others keep it concealed. Erlanthar wears his as a medallion around his neck when he is certain that he's not heading into a potential captive situation—sometimes openly and sometimes tucked away. Members of the Order of the Gauntlet wear their holy symbols openly. (Frume's is the right-handed gauntlet of Torm.) The order's universal symbol is a gauntlet grasping a sword by the blade. Frume wears such a symbol on a pendant around his neck, hidden below his flowing beard.

corrections.english: The dragons have no need to judge the different factions of the Sword Coast, for they know of their reputations and actions already. The dragons' attitudes are effectively fixed in that regard. However, they know also that among all the humanoid races, leaders often determine the character of societies. Though they understand that the adventurers are not the nominal leaders of any faction, the dragons already know that the heroes' actions have set the course of the factions' battle against {@creature Tiamat|RoT}. As such, if the dragons side with the humanoids, it will be as a statement of personal faith in the party—and in the party's ability to bring all the factions into the fight.

corrections.english: To join a guild, one must possess a background, a proficiency, or a status that the guild values. For example, a character with the sailor background is welcome to join the Master Mariners' Guild. One can practice a profession and not be a guild member, but such autonomy carries a cost. The guilds do everything they can to entice new members to join and pay for membership, and they go out of their way to hinder independent business owners, up to and including driving them out of business. A baker who refuses to join the Bakers' Guild might find her flour supply cut off, while a wizard who refuses to join the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors might be denied access to sages, libraries, and other useful resources.

corrections.english: If the characters intend to fix up and reopen the tavern in Trollskull Alley, they can expect to deal with various guilds without whose support the business is likely to fail. The Cellarers' and Plumbers' Guild is best equipped to handle the refurbishing of the basement and plumbing. Clean bedsheets are provided by the Launderers' Guild. The streets around the establishment are kept up by the Dungsweepers' Guild and the Loyal Order of Street Laborers. corrections.english: A few years ago, Dagult Neverember was ousted as Open Lord of Waterdeep. Laeral reluctantly stepped into the vacancy at the request of the Masked Lords, and has served as Waterdeep's Open Lord ever since. Initially overwhelmed by the demands of the nobles and guildmasters, she has settled nicely into her new role. She uses her magic sparingly and relies on trusted advisors and deputies. As time allows, she likes to venture outside the Palace of Waterdeep in disguise, just to clear her head or check up on old friends (and enemies).

corrections.english: Many small rituals are held throughout this day, dedicated to honoring the first Open Lord. The Lords of Waterdeep toast Ahghairon and the Watchful Order, and guildmasters toast the Lords in Ahghairon's name. Commoners leave violets (Ahghairon's favorite flower) around Ahghairon's Tower, on his statue in the City of the Dead, and atop the altars of the House of Wonder. Bards perform songs in honor of the wizard all over the city. The Open Lord visits taverns and inns throughout Waterdeep to wish the people well-giving short speeches, offering toasts to Ahghairon's memory, buying rounds of drinks, or paying for meals or accommodation. Needless to say, establishments of those sorts are generally full throughout the day.

Makers and vendors of weapons sell their wares openly in the markets, experts who can hurl or juggle weapons show off their skills, and the wards compete in wrestling and boxing matches. The most anticipated part of the day is when horses are cleared from the Field of Triumph and the surrounding streets so that the Griffon Cavalry can perform aerial displays over the crowds in the stadium. Members of the Watchful Order present the cavalry with illusory foes to fight, allowing the griffon riders to engage in thrilling battles as the people watch.

corrections.english: Shortly after Teremini Nightsedge's soldiers seized the rod fragment from the peylon tree, the Blue Fire Wardens assaulted the Three Moons Vault. They refer to their attack as the Night of Blue Fire. Teremini, a renegade from the Mages of High Sorcery's Order of the Red Robes, foresaw the attack and used powerful lunar magic to create a shroud of transformative red moonlight around the vault. {@creature Werewolf||Werewolves} that step into this moonlight lose control of their powers and succumb to raw, animalistic instinct, making it easier for Teremini to manipulate or trap them.

corrections.english: The lairds and merchants who sit at this council make sure that trade and commerce flow smoothly. They employ slave labor to maintain trade routes in the dangerous Underdark, and are always open to hiring explorers to check out leads on potential new routes. Expendable outsiders hired as caravan guards always take point and receive little aid or support from the caravan masters. Despite these unfair assignments, the duergar always live up to their bargains, paying survivors as promised.

corrections.english: Anyone who touches the gem risks falling prey to delusional madness. A duergar ale merchant named Krimgol Muzgardt found the gem and took it to Mantol-Derith. By the time he arrived, Krimgol had succumbed to the delusion that he was a {@i calassabrak}—a duergar without honor. He paid Yantha Coaxrock, an honest svirfneblin mage, to appraise the jewel, hoping that he could use it to buy back the goodwill of his clan. Touched by the gem's madness, Yantha lied to Krimgol and told him the gem was worthless. She offered a lump of gold in exchange, whereupon Krimgol suspected treachery and demanded the gem's immediate return. While Krimgol and Yantha argued, one of Yantha's apprentices tried to hide the gem for his mistress but succumbed to its evil power. The apprentice, Flink, took the gem to the drow enclave, hoping to trade it for some rare spell components that he imagined Yantha needing to make Krimgol go away. A gargoyle assigned to watch for thieves spotted the gem and wrested it from Flink, who hid for fear of incurring Yantha's wrath. Soon thereafter, the delusional gargoyle laid eyes on a drow assassin named {@creature Kinyel Druu'giir|OotA} and was instantly smitten by her. The gargoyle gave her the black gem as a token of its devotion, which she, in her madness, mistook as a payment from the drow enclave to assassinate {@creature Lorthuun|OotA}, a maimed beholder allied with the Zhentarim.
corrections.before: 任何觸控寶石的人都可能陷入妄想的瘋狂。一個名叫克林戈·穆茲加特的灰矮人麥芽酒商人發現了這塊寶石，並將其帶到曼塔-岱瑞絲。到他到達時，克林戈已經陷入了妄想，認為自己是一個沒有榮譽的灰矮人{@i 卡拉薩布拉克}。他付錢給一個誠實的地底侏儒法師揚薩·寇克斯洛克來評估這顆寶石，希望他能用它來買回他部族的好感。揚薩在寶石的瘋狂影響下，對克林戈撒謊說寶石毫無價值。她提供了一塊金子作為交換，於是克林戈懷疑有陰謀並要求立即歸還寶石。當克林戈和揚薩爭論時，揚薩的一個學徒試圖為他的女主人藏起寶石，但屈服於它的邪惡力量。這個學徒，弗林克，帶著寶石去了卓爾的飛地，希望用它交換一些他認為揚薩需要的稀有法術成分，以讓克林戈離開。一隻被指派守望小偷的石像鬼發現了寶石，並從弗林克手中奪走了它，弗林克因害怕招致揚薩的憤怒而躲藏起來。不久之後，陷入妄想的石像鬼看到了一個名叫{@creature Kinyel Druu'giir|OotA|金耶爾·德魯吉爾}的卓爾刺客，並立刻被她迷住了。石像鬼將黑色寶石作為其忠誠的象徵送給了她，而她在瘋狂中誤以為這是來自卓爾飛地的報酬，以暗殺與散塔林會結盟的受傷的眼魔{@creature Lorthuun|OotA|洛瑟恩}。

corrections.english: A duergar ale merchant named Krimgol Muzgardt asked Flink's mistress, Yantha Coaxrock, to appraise a large black gemstone. For reasons unknown to Flink, Yantha didn't want to give the gemstone back to the duergar and instead offered him a lump of gold in trade. An argument ensued.
corrections.before: 一個名叫克林戈·穆茲加特的灰矮人啤酒商人請弗林克的主人，揚薩·寇克斯洛克，評估一顆大黑寶石。出於弗林克不知道的原因，揚薩不想將寶石歸還給灰矮人，而是向他提供了一塊金子作為交換。隨後發生了爭論。
corrections.zh_tw: 一個名叫克林戈·穆茲加特的灰矮人啤酒商人請弗林克的師父，揚薩·寇克斯洛克，評估一顆大黑寶石。出於弗林克不知道的原因，揚薩不想將寶石歸還給灰矮人，而是向他提供了一塊金子作為交換。隨後發生了爭論。
reasons: 同一師徒關係。

corrections.english: This angel reaches toward the ceiling, its face a mask of hatred. A creature that makes contact with this angel must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw, taking {@dice 3d6} psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
corrections.before: 這個天使向天花板伸出手，它的臉是一張充滿仇恨的面具。任何與之接觸的生物必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 感知豁免檢定，若失敗則受到 {@dice 3d6} 點心靈傷害，成功則受到一半傷害。
corrections.zh_tw: 這個天使向天花板伸出手，滿臉仇恨。任何與之接觸的生物必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 感知豁免檢定，若失敗則受到 {@dice 3d6} 點心靈傷害，成功則受到一半傷害。
reasons: mask of hatred 描述表情，不是道具。

corrections.english: It might well be that the kuo-toa's former masters—the mind flayers—used them as ferry pilots and navigators in the Underdark, and the fish-folk continue to do so out of habit or some deep-seated need. Certainly, their relative usefulness to the other races of the Underdark has served the kuo-toa well. Only the duergar have shown any interest in navigating the waters of the Darklake on their own, and not even they do it as well as the kuo-toa.
corrections.before: 很可能寇濤魚人的前主人——靈吸怪——在幽暗地域中使用他們作為擺渡飛行員和導航員，而魚人出於習慣或某種根深蒂固的需求繼續這樣做。當然，他們對幽暗地域其他種族的相對有用性對寇濤魚人來說很有幫助。只有灰矮人表現出了獨自航行黑暗湖水域的興趣，甚至他們也沒有寇濤魚人做得好。
corrections.zh_tw: 很可能寇濤魚人的前主人——靈吸怪——在幽暗地域中使用他們作為渡船舵手和領航員，而魚人出於習慣或某種根深蒂固的需求繼續這樣做。當然，他們對幽暗地域其他種族的相對有用性對寇濤魚人來說很有幫助。只有灰矮人表現出了獨自航行黑暗湖水域的興趣，甚至他們也沒有寇濤魚人做得好。
reasons: ferry pilots 指渡船駕駛，非飛行員。

corrections.english: "The only one of my kind who could ever match me in the Art is Gromph Baenre. I think we knew from the moment we met that we were destined to be rivals. But where I sought only to master the Art, Gromph was also an astute political manipulator. No more devout than I in the service of the Spider Queen, he arranged for my disgrace and exile. Deprived of my considerable skills, my house fell to our rival, House Do'Urden. Gromph became the Archmage of Menzoberranzan under the auspices of his own house, the First House of the Ruling Council.
corrections.before: "唯一一個在藝術上能與我匹敵的我的同類是貢夫·班瑞。我認為從我們見面的那一刻起，我們就知道我們註定要成為對手。但我尋求的只是掌握藝術，貢夫也是一個精明的政治操縱者。他並不比我更虔誠地為蜘蛛女王服務，他安排了我的恥辱和流放。失去了我相當的能力，我的家族倒在了我們的對手杜堊登家族手中。貢夫在自己的家族，統治委員會的第一家族的支援下，成為了魔索布萊城的大法師。"
corrections.zh_tw: "唯一一個在魔法技藝上能與我匹敵的我的同類是貢夫·班瑞。我認為從我們見面的那一刻起，我們就知道我們註定要成為對手。但我尋求的只是掌握魔法技藝，貢夫也是一個精明的政治操縱者。他並不比我更虔誠地為蜘蛛女王服務，他安排了我的恥辱和流放。失去了我相當的能力，我的家族倒在了我們的對手杜堊登家族手中。貢夫在自己的家族，統治委員會的第一家族的支援下，成為了魔索布萊城的大法師。"
reasons: 維茲蘭與貢夫競爭的 Art 為施法技藝。

corrections.english: The Underdark has always been a proving ground for candidates of the order, as well as a frequent destination for veteran paladins, monks, and clerics looking to smite evil. It hasn't taken long for reports of new threats rising in the Underdark to reach the order.
corrections.before: 幽暗地域一直是該秩序候選人的試煉場，也是經驗豐富的聖武士、僧侶和牧師尋求打擊邪惡的常去之地。關於幽暗地域新威脅上升的報告很快就傳到了秩序中。
corrections.zh_tw: 幽暗地域一直是該教團候選人的試煉場，也是經驗豐富的聖武士、僧侶和牧師尋求打擊邪惡的常去之地。關於幽暗地域新威脅上升的報告很快就傳到了教團中。
reasons: order 指鐵手套教團。

corrections.english: If he's of a mind to provide aid, Sir Lanniver pledges five human veterans of the order to the party's mission. The veterans' names are Thora Nabal, Sylrien Havennor, Olaf Renghyi, Elias Drako, and Tamryn Tharke. Sir Lanniver can also offer a member of the party a {@item +1 warhammer}, one of a handful of treasures held in trust by the order. He prefers to bestow this weapon on a good- or neutral-aligned cleric or paladin. Feel free to swap this magic weapon with another magic item more useful to the adventurers.
corrections.before: 如果他願意提供幫助，蘭尼弗爵士承諾向隊伍的任務提供五名人類老兵。這些老兵的名字是索拉·納巴爾、西爾裡恩·哈文諾、奧拉夫·倫吉、伊萊亞斯·德拉科和塔姆林·薩克。蘭尼弗爵士還可以向隊伍的一名成員提供一件{@item +1 warhammer||+1 戰錘}，這是秩序保管的少數寶藏之一。他更願意將這件魔法武器贈予善良或中立陣營的牧師或聖武士。如果這把魔法武器對冒險者來說不如其他魔法物品有用，請隨意更換。
corrections.zh_tw: 如果他願意提供幫助，蘭尼弗爵士承諾向隊伍的任務提供五名人類老兵。這些老兵的名字是索拉·納巴爾、西爾裡恩·哈文諾、奧拉夫·倫吉、伊萊亞斯·德拉科和塔姆林·薩克。蘭尼弗爵士還可以向隊伍的一名成員提供一件{@item +1 warhammer||+1 戰錘}，這是教團保管的少數寶藏之一。他更願意將這件魔法武器贈予善良或中立陣營的牧師或聖武士。如果這把魔法武器對冒險者來說不如其他魔法物品有用，請隨意更換。
reasons: order 指鐵手套教團。

corrections.english: The Lords' Alliance is a political and economic coalition of cities spread throughout the North and the Sword Coast. The alliance owes its success to effective cooperation and diplomacy between its members, who work to align their separate settlements toward a mutual purpose. This cooperation is easier during times of crisis, making the Lords' Alliance a powerful force when threats require a united front. The agents of the Lords' Alliance work to maintain the delicate network of information and diplomacy that sustains their order, alert for anything that might threaten the alliance's interests. Recent reports of unusual activity from the Underdark might mark one such threat.
corrections.before: 領主聯盟是一個政治和經濟聯盟，其城市遍佈北方和劍海岸。聯盟的成功歸功於其成員之間有效的合作和外交，他們共同努力將各自的定居點統一到一個共同的目標。在危機時期，這種合作更容易實現，使領主聯盟在需要團結一致的威脅面前成為一個強大的力量。領主聯盟的代理人致力於維護維持他們秩序的複雜資訊和外交網路，警惕任何可能威脅到聯盟利益的事情。最近有關幽暗地域異常活動的報告可能標誌著這樣一個威脅。
corrections.zh_tw: 領主聯盟是一個政治和經濟聯盟，其城市遍佈北方和劍海岸。聯盟的成功歸功於其成員之間有效的合作和外交，他們共同努力將各自的定居點統一到一個共同的目標。在危機時期，這種合作更容易實現，使領主聯盟在需要團結一致的威脅面前成為一個強大的力量。領主聯盟的代理人致力於維護維持他們聯盟的複雜資訊和外交網路，警惕任何可能威脅到聯盟利益的事情。最近有關幽暗地域異常活動的報告可能標誌著這樣一個威脅。
reasons: order 指領主聯盟組織。

corrections.english: Escobert is a shield dwarf with knotted, tangled, bright red hair. As master of the keep, Escobert is in charge of its defense and is the best source of information on the tunnel and the sally port (see "{@area The Old Tunnel|074|x}" and "{@area The Sally Port|078|x}" below). He carries an enormous ring of iron and brass keys to the many locks in the keep.
corrections.before: 埃斯科伯特是一個盾矮人，有著打結、凌亂、鮮紅色的頭髮。作為城堡的主人，埃斯科伯特負責其防禦，並且是關於隧道和突擊口（見下文"{@area 古老的隧道|074|x}"和"{@area 出擊口|078|x}"）的最佳資訊來源。他攜帶著一個巨大的鐵和黃銅鑰匙環，用於城堡中的許多鎖。
reasons: 所屬標題 Castellan Escobert the Red，master of the keep 是總管職務。
corrections.zh_tw: 埃斯科伯特是一個盾矮人，有著打結、凌亂、鮮紅色的頭髮。作為城堡總管，埃斯科伯特負責其防禦，並且是關於隧道和突擊口（見下文"{@area 古老的隧道|074|x}"和"{@area 出擊口|078|x}"）的最佳資訊來源。他攜帶著一個巨大的鐵和黃銅鑰匙環，用於城堡中的許多鎖。

corrections.before: {@creature Strahd, Master of Death House|VEoR|施特拉德，死亡之主}

corrections.before: 到達死亡之屋後，{@creature Strahd, Master of Death House|VEoR|施特拉德，死亡之主}（見{@area 附錄 B|566|x}）在房子的主廳（{@area 區域D2a|243|x}）等待角色們。他由兩個{@creature vampire spawn||初生吸血鬼}陪同。

positiveControls.english: Gentle-sounding music trickles down from above, played on a single stringed instrument by some unseen master.
positiveControls.zh_tw: 輕柔的音樂從上方流淌而下，由某位看不見的大師用一把絃樂器演奏。

positiveControls.english: Since bidding farewell to van Richten, Ezmerelda has amassed a sizable personal fortune, some of which she used to buy a wagon to carry her vampire-slaying paraphernalia. On one of her less successful adventures, a werewolf bit off her right leg below the knee, and although she avoided being afflicted with lycanthropy, Ezmerelda was sidelined for months. She commissioned a master artisan to craft a prosthetic lower leg and foot. After several tries, he delivered a prosthesis that restored her mobility. She has since adapted well to the false appendage.
positiveControls.zh_tw: 自從告別了範·裡希騰，艾絲美拉達已經積累了一筆可觀的個人財富，其中的一些她用來購買了一輛馬車，用以攜帶她獵殺吸血鬼的裝備。在一次不太成功的冒險中，一頭狼人咬掉了她膝蓋以下的右腿，儘管沒有患上狼化症，艾絲美拉達還是養了好幾個月的傷。她委託一位工匠大師手工製作了一個包含小腿和腳部的義肢。幾經嘗試後，那名工匠做出了一個恢復了她移動力的義肢。從那以後她就很好地適應了這條假肢，並小心地將其隱藏起來。

positiveControls.english: The Vistani have long been masters of fortune-telling. In the hands of a Vistani seer, a {@deck Tarokka Deck|CoS|deck of tarokka cards} can tell tales of the future and provide answers to many a dark and mysterious question.
positiveControls.zh_tw: 維斯塔尼人長久以來一直是算命的大師。在維斯塔尼預言者的手中，一副{@deck Tarokka Deck|CoS|塔羅卡牌組}能夠講述未來的故事，併為許多黑暗而神秘的問題提供答案。

positiveControls.english: For more than three decades now, I have undertaken to investigate and expose creatures of darkness to the purifying light of truth and knowledge. "Hero" I am named in some circles; "sage" and "master hunter" I am called in others. That I have survived countless supernatural assaults is seen as a marvel among my peers; my name is spoken with fear and loathing among my foes.
positiveControls.zh_tw: 三十多年來，我一直致力於調查並將黑暗生物暴露在真理與知識的淨化之光中。在某些圈子裡，我被稱作"英雄"；在另一些圈子裡，我被尊為"賢者"和"獵人大師"。我在無數超自然襲擊中倖存下來，這被我的同行視為奇蹟；而我的名字在敵人中則伴隨著恐懼與憎惡被提及。
positiveControls.reason: master hunter 技藝稱號保留

positiveControls.english: {@creature Vilnius|CoS} wears scorched robes, his unkempt hair is half burned away, and his face and arms are covered with blisters from magic fire. He is the apprentice of Jakarion, the dead wizard in {@area area X17|604|x}. After the flameskulls there incinerated his master, the wounded {@creature Vilnius|CoS} retreated here. He eats vermin to survive. The {@creature amber golem|CoS} has been patrolling the hallway outside ({@area area X8|5ee|x}), and {@creature Vilnius|CoS} won't leave this room until he knows the golem has been destroyed.
positiveControls.zh_tw: {@creature Vilnius|CoS|維爾紐斯}穿著燒焦的長袍，他蓬亂的頭髮被燒掉了一半，臉和手臂上佈滿了魔法火焰造成的水泡。他是{@area 區域X17|604|x}中死去的法師賈卡里翁的學徒。在那裡的燃焰之顱將他的師父燒成灰燼後，受傷的{@creature Vilnius|CoS|維爾紐斯} 撤退到了這裡。他靠吃蟲子維生。{@creature amber golem|CoS|琥珀魔像}一直在外面的走廊（{@area 區域X8|5ee|x}）巡邏，而 {@creature Vilnius|CoS|維爾紐斯} 在知道魔像被摧毀之前不會離開這個房間。

positiveControls.english: {@creature Volenta Popofsky|CoS} wears a faded gold wedding gown, a platinum mask shaped vaguely like a skull (750 gp), and ten platinum rings set with gemstones (worth 250 gp each).
positiveControls.zh_tw: {@creature Volenta Popofsky|CoS|瓦倫塔·波波夫斯基} 穿著一件褪色的金色婚紗，一張造型模糊如頭骨的鉑金面具（750 gp），以及十枚鑲著寶石的鉑金戒指（每枚價值250 gp）。

positiveControls.english: The Emerald Enclave is dedicated to maintaining balance in the natural order and combating the forces that threaten that balance. Members of the enclave live in the wilderness or in small communities, and the order has almost no representatives in towns and cities. They are not opposed to civilization, however. Rather, they seek to prevent civilization and wilderness from harming one another. Those who serve the Emerald Enclave are masters of survival and living off the land, of navigating through the wilderness, and of reading the signs that indicate approaching weather, the passage of creatures, and the general weal of the natural world.
positiveControls.zh_tw: 翠綠閒庭致力於維護自然秩序的平衡，並對抗威脅這種平衡的力量。聯盟的成員生活在荒野或小社群中，該組織在城鎮和城市中幾乎沒有代表。然而，他們並不反對文明。相反，他們尋求防止文明和荒野相互傷害。那些為翠綠閒庭服務的人是生存的大師，擅長在土地上生活，穿越荒野，解讀指示即將到來的天氣、生物的通行和自然界總體狀況的跡象。
positiveControls.reason: 自然秩序及生存大師保留

positiveControls.english: Ilda is a neutral good {@creature ghost} who was once one of {@creature Diderius|RoT}'s apprentices. She worshiped her master, but was mistakenly banished as a thief when one of his prize tomes was misplaced. Ilda died not long after {@creature Diderius|RoT}, and her spirit returned here to act as caretaker to his great stores of knowledge.
positiveControls.zh_tw: 伊爾達是一箇中立善良的{@creature ghost||幽魂}，曾經是{@creature Diderius|RoT|迪德里烏斯}的學徒之一。她非常崇拜她的師傅，但當一本他珍貴的書籍遺失時，她被誤認為是小偷而被放逐。伊爾達在{@creature Diderius|RoT|迪德里烏斯}去世後不久就去世了，她的靈魂回到了這裡，作為他龐大知識庫的守護者。

positiveControls.english: {@b "Dabbler but no master" and "No mastery blazing forth"} These idioms trace their origin to Ahghairon, who early on in his studies of magic humbly said, "I am no wizard. I am a dabbler but no master of magic; it seems no mastery burns within me." Both now serve as expressions of false modesty applied to any skill or craft, not just magic use.
positiveControls.zh_tw: {@b "涉獵者但非大師"和"沒有顯露出精通"} 這些成語起源於阿蓋爾倫，在他對魔法的研究初期謙遜地說："我不是法師。我是一個涉獵者，但不是魔法的大師；似乎我內心沒有燃燒的精通之光。" 現在這兩個成語都作為對任何技能或手藝的虛假謙虛的表達，而不僅僅是魔法的使用。
positiveControls.reason: 技艺語境的魔法大師保留

positiveControls.english: Suddenly a white-haired man bolts toward the crowd, his face a mask of terror. Behind him lurches a massive, green-skinned giant dragging a ball and chain across the cobbled street. A blind helm covers the troll's eyes, but its mouth is a veritable cavern of sharp teeth. It flails its arms, slashing at the fog around it, and lets out a horrible wail of frustration. The crowd panics at the sight of it and flees into the mist and rain. Meanwhile, two members of the City Watch sneak up behind the blind troll, hoping to strike a mortal blow.
positiveControls.zh_tw: 突然一個白髮男子驚恐地衝向人群，臉上寫滿恐懼。他身後蹣跚跟隨著一個拖著鐵球鎖鏈的綠色巨怪，鎖鏈在鵝卵石街道上刮出刺耳聲響。巨怪雙目被盲盔遮蔽，但那張血盆大口布滿獠牙。它暴躁地揮舞雙臂劈砍周圍霧氣，發出令人膽寒的挫敗嚎叫。目睹此景的人群在雨霧中四散奔逃。此刻兩名城市守衛正潛行至盲眼巨怪背後，企圖給予致命一擊。
positiveControls.reason: 既有表情比喻正譯保留
